questions.prompt: Which of these is a private (RFC 1918) address?
Routers on the public Internet will forward a packet addressed to 10.1.2.3.
What is the loopback address almost everyone uses? (dotted decimal)
You run ping 127.0.0.1 and it fails. What does that tell you?
options: The problem is in this host's own network software, since that traffic never leaves the machine

questions.prompt: What does NAT need, at a minimum, to connect a private network to the Internet?
options: A DHCP server on the Internet
Two or more network interfaces: one inside, one outside with a public address

questions.prompt: NAT lets many private hosts share a single public IP address.
What RFC number defines the private address ranges? (just the number)
A laptop shows the address 169.254.33.7. What most likely happened?
options: It asked for an address with DHCP and got no answer, so it gave itself a link-local one
It's on a class D network
